title: Pickety Configuration
description: Configuration for Pickety, a high-performance architectural enforcement engine for TypeScript.

modules.description: Map module names to file glob patterns. Files belong to the first module that matches.
modules.markdownDescription:
Map module names to file glob patterns. Files belong to the first module that matches.

Example:
```json
{
  "features": "src/features/*",
  "components": "src/components/**/*"
}
```

additionalProperties.description: Glob pattern for the module files.

importer.description: Source module name or glob pattern.
importer.markdownDescription:
Source module name or glob pattern.

Supports `$variable` interpolation to match importer subdirectories with target subdirectories.

imports.description: Target module name, glob, or relative path pattern.
imports.markdownDescription:
Target module name, glob, or relative path pattern.

Supports `$variable` interpolation.

allow.description: Permit or deny the import. Defaults to false (deny).

only.description: If true, the 'imports' target can ONLY be imported by the specified 'importer'. Everyone else is forbidden.

containedTo.description: Restrict the 'imports' target to be contained within this importer pattern. Shortcut for 'only: true'.

unless.description: Skip this rule when ALL captured variables match the specified values (AND semantics). Keys must be $variable names present in 'imports'.

message.description: Custom error message shown in the editor.

severity.description: Override the global severity for this specific rule.

name.description: Unique identifier for the rule. Used in diagnostics and 'Go to Rule' navigation.

maxViolations.description: Debt threshold: if total violations for this rule are at or below this number, they are downgraded to warnings. Exceeding the threshold escalates all violations to errors.
maxViolations.markdownDescription:
Debt threshold for gradual adoption.

- Violations **at or below** this count → downgraded to `warn`
- Violations **exceeding** this count → escalated to `error`

Set this to your current violation count and ratchet it down over time.

boundary-diagrams.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram on save.
boundary-diagrams.markdownDescription:
Automatically generate a Mermaid diagram of module boundaries on every save.

- `true`: Writes to `picket-boundaries.mermaid` in workspace root.
- `"path/to/file.mermaid"`: Writes to a custom path.

health.description: Module health thresholds. Violations appear as diagnostics on pickety.json.
health.markdownDescription:
Set thresholds for module health metrics. When a module exceeds a threshold, a diagnostic warning or error is reported on `pickety.json`.

All fields are optional — only configured thresholds are enforced.

maxAfferentCoupling.description: Maximum number of modules that may depend on any single module (Ca).
maxAfferentCoupling.markdownDescription:
Maximum **afferent coupling (Ca)** — the number of other modules that depend on a given module.

High Ca means the module is heavily depended upon; changing it is risky.

maxEfferentCoupling.description: Maximum number of modules any single module may depend on (Ce).
maxEfferentCoupling.markdownDescription:
Maximum **efferent coupling (Ce)** — the number of other modules a given module depends on.

High Ce means the module is fragile and sensitive to external changes.

maxInstability.description: Maximum instability ratio Ce/(Ca+Ce) for any module, between 0 and 1.
maxInstability.markdownDescription:
Maximum **instability (I)** — `Ce / (Ca + Ce)`.

- `0` = maximally stable (everyone depends on it, it depends on nothing)
- `1` = maximally unstable (it depends on others, nothing depends on it)

maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency chain depth for any module.
maxDepth.markdownDescription:
Maximum **dependency depth** — the longest chain from a module to a leaf in the dependency graph.

Deep chains mean changes cascade further through the architecture.
